verdict.rationale: Number portability is a fair question for a cloud phone provider like Dialpad, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers porting numbers out, lock-in or exit fees, or showing the account details a gaining carrier needs in the app. The items cover APIs, webhooks, MCP, pricing features and recordings, none of which concern port-out.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
